questions.question: What does a NavigationLink(value:) need its value to be?
questions.why: The stack's path stores values, which must be hashable.

questions.question: Which view shows a sidebar and detail on iPad and Mac, and a stack on iPhone?
questions.why: It adapts its columns to the available space.

questions.question: In iOS 27, how do you add swipe actions to cards in a ScrollView?

answers.text: Add .swipeActions to the cards and .swipeActionsContainer() to the scroll view

questions.why: iOS 27 brought swipe actions to any scrolling container.

questions.question: What is the best way to show an empty detail column?
questions.why: It is the system's standard empty state.
